description: This file contains the implementation of classes 'FormulaNode' and 'FormulaCalculator' used for parsing, evaluating, and managing formulas within the SuiteCRM system, including configuration handling and variable replacement.

classes.name: FormulaNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the formula parse tree, holding text, level, parent, children, and evaluated value.

classes.name: FormulaCalculator
classes.description: Performs parsing, evaluating formulas; handles configuration, global variables, date/time calculations, and complex expression evaluation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes FormulaCalculator with parameters, loads configuration, and sets debug options.

methods.name: calculateFormula
methods.description: Evaluates a formula string by building a parse tree and computing its value.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug information if debug is enabled.

methods.name: createTree
methods.description: Creates a parse tree from a formula string.

methods.name: findLexicalElementsOnLevel
methods.description: Recursively identifies sub-expressions within the formula text based on delimiters.

methods.name: evaluateTreeLevel
methods.description: Recursively evaluates nodes in the parse tree, resolving leaf nodes and combining child evaluations for non-leaf nodes.

methods.name: evaluateNode
methods.description: Interprets and evaluates a node's text, handling functions, logical expressions, string manipulations, math, and date functions.

methods.name: evaluateLeaf
methods.description: Replaces parameter placeholders with actual parameter values.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariables
methods.description: Replaces known global variable placeholders with their current values.

methods.name: replaceGlobalVariable
methods.description: Handles specific global variable replacement and increments the counter.

methods.name: getGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current value of global counters/configuration variables.

methods.name: setGlobalVariableConfig
methods.description: Updates configuration variables and saves to configuration file.

methods.name: formatCounter
methods.description: Formats counter values with leading zeros.

methods.name: getDBFormat
methods.description: Converts date/datetime strings into database format, handling timezones and formats appropriately.

methods.name: modifyDate
methods.description: Adds or subtracts time units from date strings based on parameters.

methods.name: evaluateFunctionParams
methods.description: Extracts function parameters from formula string for evaluation.

methods.name: getFunctionParameters
methods.description: Parses and returns an array of parameters for a specific function call within a formula.

methods.name: getParameterArray
methods.description: Extracts individual parameters from function call text, considering nested parentheses.

methods.name: getParameterText
methods.description: Extracts the raw parameter string from a function call.

methods.name: parseFloat
methods.description: Converts a string to float, replacing commas with dots for decimal notation.

methods.name: evaluateLeaf
methods.description: Replaces placeholders like {P0}, {R0} with actual parameters in leaf nodes.

methods.name: logVardump
methods.description: Logs the structure of objects or arrays for debugging.
